Counter check: page header claims "Total Shipments 10117" and "Trading Partners 21", but the free view rendered only 4 shipment rows and 5 supplier/buyer rows — so the 10,117 figure is a platform counter, NOT verified row-by-row; only 4 concrete dated export rows were actually seen. note: Export side is factually confirmed by dated customs bill-of-lading records (BOL 1090659, 2026-02-27, Nhava Sheva -> Hamburg, Germany), so this is a real shipper, not a website claim. HS discrepancy: declared HS 570339 (carpets/floor coverings, tufted) vs actual records 57050039, 57050042 and 63041910 — per project rule 3 this is NOT grounds for rejection; the company stays in the base and the HS code should be corrected to the observed 5705/6304 lines. Industry claim "Продукты питания и FMCG" (food/FMCG) is contradicted by the shipment record: the goods are jute/cotton braided rugs, bed covers and corner rugs — home textiles, not food. Role: manufacturer_trader is plausible (own plot address at Plot No. E-42, Industrial Area, Panipat-type textile cluster, shipping own-branded goods to German and Australian retail importers) but the manufacturer/trader split is not proven by the records seen. Domestic supply: no traces of domestic supply found in the sources accessible in this run — status left as unknown rather than none_found, because the search backend was unavailable and absence of evidence here is not evidence of absence. Revenue and export volume: null, not public in the free views.
